Tests that streaming requests bypass cache entirely

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}")
let _client = try createClientFromJson(json: "{\"api_key\":\"your-api-key\",\"cache\":{\"backend\":\"memory\",\"max_entries\":256,\"ttl_seconds\":300}}")
let result = try await _client.chatStream(_req)
var chunks: [LiterLlm.ChatCompletionChunk] = []
        for try await _chunk in result { chunks.append(_chunk) }
print(result)
```
